description: Implementing a 'Home Composting' Project in collaboration with Provincial Councils and Local Authorities as a component of the 'Clean Sri Lanka -Pivithuru Purawara' National Solid Waste Management Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that 50% - 60% of the solid waste generated daily in Sri Lanka consists of biodegradable organic materials and that converting the aforesaid waste into compost at the household level can significantly reduce the financial and operational costs associated with waste collection, transportation, segregation, recycling, and final disposal. Therefore, as a sustainable solution covering the entire waste lifecycle from generation to final disposal, it has been planned to implement a project to convert household generated biodegradable waste into compost under the 'Clean Sri Lanka - Pivithuru Purawara' National Solid Waste Management Project scheduled to be implemented during the period of 2027 ‑ 2029 as one component thereof. Under this project, household compost bins will be provided to the housing units concerned and the process of converting biodegradable waste into compost within the respective household premises will be continued with a view to designating street segments selected by Local Authorities covering all Local Authorities as areas where organic waste collection services are not provided. The intervention seeks to integrate several key components into a single, operational system: the provision of the necessary physical infrastructure to convert waste into compost (compost bins), the transfer of knowledge and technical guidance, supervision by all Local Authorities and the continuous practice of composting at household levels. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to implement the Home Composting Project initially covering the Western and Southern Provinces as one of the projects of the three-year 'Clean Sri Lanka - Pivithuru Purawara' National Solid Waste Management Project and to expand the project to other Provinces based on its success, was approved by the Cabinet.
